audit_items.proof_trace: ServiceTxFilter marks ANY zero-gas-price transaction as IsServiceTransaction=true without validating sender is Address.SystemUser (0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffe). External attackers can craft zero-gas-price transactions to bypass base fee validation and gain service transaction privileges.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts transaction with GasPrice=0 and MaxFeePerGas=0 from their own address. ServiceTxFilter.IsAllowed sets IsServiceTransaction=true, bypassing BaseFeeTxFilter validation and granting system transaction privileges to non-system address.
